name: Grafana alert to Teams Adaptive Card (Preview)
description:
## What it does

Receives a Grafana Alertmanager-compatible webhook and renders firing or resolved alert groups, including each alert instance, metric values, timestamps, and Grafana links, as an Adaptive Card using **Webhook → Code → DevX Message Connector**.

## Setup

1. Add a **DevX Message Connector** credential containing the full Teams channel link and configure `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL` and `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_KEY`.
2. While editing, POST a Grafana payload to `/webhook-test/devx/grafana-alert` and inspect the Preview response. Add Header Auth to the Webhook when using `GRAFANA_ALERT_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
3. Activate the workflow and set `GRAFANA_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL` to `/webhook/devx/grafana-alert`. Change **Mode** to **Send** only after reviewing the card.

## Notes

Header Auth is optional in the source configuration. Preview calls `<DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL>/api/v1/messages/preview` without posting to Teams; it is not an offline transformation mode. The Webhook responds immediately, so acceptance does not confirm Teams delivery. The Code node is the exact script from the [source runbook](https://bcgov.github.io/common-hosted-workflow/operations/grafana-alert-notifications). No credentials or pinned execution data are included.
